title: js65 project file
description: Compilation units the js65 language server assembles. Paths resolve against this file's directory.

name.description: Human-readable unit name. Defaults to the first source's basename.

sources.description: Entry source files assembled for this unit.

linkerConfig.description: Path to an ld65 config file. Linking runs on save to surface segment-overflow errors.

target.description: Built-in target layout, used when no linkerConfig is given.
